Laboratory.cell: Pheasant Memorial Laboratory (PML) for Geochemistry and Cosmochemistry, Okayama University (affiliation)
Laboratory.value: Pheasant Memorial Laboratory (PML) for Geochemistry and Cosmochemistry, Okayama University (affiliation)

Target Material.cell: Silicate reference materials (basalt, andesite, peridotite), NIST SRM glasses, carbonaceous chondrites (stated section 2)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Test portion / solution aliquot -- "The amount of test portion used was 15-42 mg for basalt and andesite samples, and 30-63 mg for peridotite samples"; NIST glasses "a few grains totalling 8-22 mg were used in one analysis"; "the same sample solution aliquot"
Sampling Unit Type.value: Test portion / solution aliquot -- "The amount of test portion used was 15-42 mg for basalt and andesite samples, and 30-63 mg for peridotite samples"; NIST glasses "a few grains totalling 8-22 mg were used in one analysis"; "the same sample solution aliquot"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Whole-rock powder or glass chips (stated section 2)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Whole-rock powder or glass chips (stated section 2)

Digestion Acid(s).cell: HF + HClO4 (basalt/glass, ultrasonic); HF alone in TFE bomb (peridotite/chondrite; stated section 2)

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: Ultrasonic bath (basalt/glass); TFE bomb at 245 deg C (peridotite/chondrite; stated section 2)
Digestion Vessel Type.value: Ultrasonic bath (basalt/glass); TFE bomb at 245 deg C (peridotite/chondrite; stated section 2)

Digestion Step.cell: Basalts, andesites and NIST SRM 612/614/616, 1: HF-HClO4 with the Sm spike in an ultrasonic bath, then dried to decompose fluorides; final uptake in 0.5 mol/l HNO3. Peridotites and carbonaceous chondrites, 1: HF with the Sm spike in a TFE bomb at 245 deg C | 2: dried with HClO4; final uptake in 0.5 mol/l HNO3.

value.member: 1: HF-HClO4 with the Sm spike in an ultrasonic bath
final uptake in 0.5 mol/l HNO3. Peridotites and carbonaceous chondrites
1: HF with the Sm spike in a TFE bomb at 245 deg C | 2: dried with HClO4

Digestion Temperature.cell: Ambient for ultrasonic; 245 deg C for TFE bomb (stated section 2)

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: 15-63 mg (silicates); 8-22 mg (NIST glass); 9-28 mg (chondrites; stated section 2)
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: 15-63 mg (silicates); 8-22 mg (NIST glass); 9-28 mg (chondrites; stated section 2)

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: 149Sm-enriched spike (used as ID internal standard for Cd, In, Tl, Bi; stated section 2)
Isotope Dilution Spike.value: 149Sm-enriched spike (used as ID internal standard for Cd, In, Tl, Bi; stated section 2)

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Agilent -- "Agilent 7500cs; Yokogawa Analytical Systems, Mitaka, Japan"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: Agilent -- "Agilent 7500cs; Yokogawa Analytical Systems, Mitaka, Japan"

Analytical Mode.cell: Flow injection -- "The pseudo-flow injection (FI) sample introduction technique, in which transient signals were integrated as total counts, was employed with the ID-IS method to minimise total sample consumption volume (~0.013 ml)"
Analytical Mode.value: Flow injection -- "The pseudo-flow injection (FI) sample introduction technique, in which transient signals were integrated as total counts, was employed with the ID-IS method to minimise total sample consumption volume (~0.013 ml)"

Target Species.cell: Cd, In, Tl, Bi (with 149Sm as ID-IS reference; stated section 2)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Cd, In, Tl and Bi mass fractions (ng g-1)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 95Mo, 111Cd, 113Cd, 115In, 118Sn, 149Sm, 205Tl, 209Bi (Table 1). Cd is determined on 111Cd only: "113Cd was not used for Cd determination, because the correction of 113In was far larger than the MoO correction"

value.member: 209Bi (Table 1). Cd is determined on 111Cd only: "113Cd was not used for Cd determination, because the correction of 113In was far larger than the MoO correction"

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: Analyte-specific: 0.11 ms per mass per scan for 95Mo/111Cd/113Cd/115In/118Sn/149Sm; 0.18 ms per mass per scan for 205Tl/209Bi (Table 1, expressed as ms per 1 s cycle)

value.value: 0.11 ms per mass per scan for 95Mo/111Cd/113Cd/115In/118Sn/149Sm

Wash Time Between Samples.cell: >=200 s in 0.5 mol/l HNO3; 200 s HF wash after Mo standard (stated section 2)
Wash Time Between Samples.value: >=200 s in 0.5 mol/l HNO3; 200 s HF wash after Mo standard (stated section 2)

Drift Correction Method.cell: IS normalization (149Sm spike ratio; stated section 2)
Drift Correction Method.value: IS normalization (149Sm spike ratio; stated section 2)

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Isotope dilution with ID-IS normalization (ID-IS; all analytes; stated section 2)

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Y (95Mo16O+ and 71Ga40Ar+ on 111Cd; 97Mo16O+/113In+ on 113Cd; 115Sn+ on 115In+; stated section 2)
Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.value: Y (95Mo16O+ and 71Ga40Ar+ on 111Cd; 97Mo16O+/113In+ on 113Cd; 115Sn+ on 115In+; stated section 2)

Interfering Species.cell: 95Mo16O+ and 71Ga40Ar+ on 111Cd; 97Mo16O+ and 113In+ on 113Cd; 115Sn+ on 115In+ (stated section 2)

Interference Correction Method.cell: Ratio-based correction using 95Mo and 118Sn monitors (stated section 2)

Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.cell: IUPAC isotope dilution equations with ID-IS internal standard normalization (stated section 2)
Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.value: IUPAC isotope dilution equations with ID-IS internal standard normalization (stated section 2)

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: >=200 s in 0.5 mol/l HNO3; 200 s HF wash after Mo standard (stated section 2)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: >=200 s in 0.5 mol/l HNO3; 200 s HF wash after Mo standard (stated section 2)

Uncertainty Level.cell: RSD% (n = 5) and RPD (relative percentage difference) -- both used; "RPD, relative percentage difference"
Uncertainty Level.value: RSD% (n = 5) and RPD (relative percentage difference) -- both used; "RPD, relative percentage difference"

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: Relative concentration factors f_G and S_Gi ("the ratio of the concentration in the solution to the signal intensity of the measured isotope") in the ID-IS equation, obtained from calibrator solutions measured before and after the sample; mass discrimination correction "based on the mean elemental ratios obtained from the calibrator solution measurements"; MoO+/Mo+ from a Mo standard run "after every sixth sample". No numeric factor values reported

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- n = 5 (evaporation test), n = 4 (dissolution blanks), "an average of eight sessions" for detection limits. No acceptance or rejection rule for individual results is stated. The 113Cd decision is a mass-selection decision, not an aggregation one, and is recorded under Monitored Masses
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- n = 5 (evaporation test), n = 4 (dissolution blanks), "an average of eight sessions" for detection limits. No acceptance or rejection rule for individual results is stated. The 113Cd decision is a mass-selection decision, not an aggregation one, and is recorded under Monitored Masses

Combination Method.cell: all: average over repeat measurements — evaporation-test ratios 'together with the RSD (n = 5)'; detection limits 'an average of eight sessions'

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: "113In/115In = 0.0448 (Rosman and Taylor 1998)" used in the In correction; "For a 94Mo/95Mo value of 0.58" and MoOH+/MoO+ "a value of ~0.15 was obtained", both used in the Mo-oxide correction
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: "113In/115In = 0.0448 (Rosman and Taylor 1998)" used in the In correction; "For a 94Mo/95Mo value of 0.58" and MoOH+/MoO+ "a value of ~0.15 was obtained", both used in the Mo-oxide correction

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: Multi-element calibrator solution (Cd, In, Tl, Bi, Sm; not formally named; stated section 2)

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: JB-2, JB-3, JA-1, JA-2, JA-3, JP-1, BHVO-1, AGV-1, PCC-1, DTS-1, NIST SRM 610/612/614/616, carbonaceous chondrites (stated in text)

Detection Limit.cell: Analyte-specific (pg/ml level; e.g., Cd 0.04 pg/ml, In 0.5 pg/ml, Tl 0.5 pg/ml, Bi 0.6 pg/ml; stated Table 1)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: %RSD of repeated standard and RM analyses (stated section 2)

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: % recovery relative to certified/consensus values for USGS/GSJ/NIST RMs (stated section 3)

Additional Notes.cell: Dwell times in Table 1 expressed as ms per 1 s cycle time; octopole CRC present but no gas used (PML practice); 149Sm used as both ID spike and internal standard
Additional Notes.value: Dwell times in Table 1 expressed as ms per 1 s cycle time; octopole CRC present but no gas used (PML practice); 149Sm used as both ID spike and internal standard
